p: Plymouth Street sits right by Swansea's bus station and the back of the Quadrant shopping centre, so if you're coming in on the bus this Stardust is about as close as it gets. Swansea Market, the big covered market, is a couple of minutes away too.

Head south and you'll soon reach the Maritime Quarter, with the free National Waterfront Museum, the marina and the beach. Swansea Bay curves round to Mumbles, which makes a lovely walk or bike ride along the prom on a nice day.
It's over-18s only here, so keep that in mind if you're out with the family.
